newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch shares end up, reaching new record high.
newsitem.headline: Dutch shares end up, reaching new record high.

text.p: 1550 GMT - Dutch shares end up at new record close but below intraday high. Company news, surrounding markets boost. * AEX index of main shares adds 4.47 points to close at 774.43, below intraday high of 779.02. * KPN gives up earlier gains, ends down 0.80 at 69.40 guilders after releasiung 1996 results in line with expectations. * BolsWessanen number two on volume list, closes 1.10 higher at 37.80 guilders on talk over sale of Italian drinks interests. * Volker Stevin adds 13.60 guilders to 202.00 after announcing intention to merge with Kondor Wessels Group. Shares of entire Dutch construction sector rise on hopes of reshuffle.
